entities.name: Dario Kostović

entities.summary: Dario Kostovic is a Swiss-Croatian former professional ice hockey player who last played for KHL Medveščak Zagreb of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He took up a head coaching position in the Swiss Junior Elite B league upon completing his professional career in the 2014–15 season.
